sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for appellant that appellant is innocent and falsely been implicated in the case.
Appellant is a woman.
There is no chance that she could commit rape with the prosecutrix.
Appellant has no knowledge that other co-accused person will commit rape on the prosecutrix.
In these circumstances, he prayed for that appellant may be enlarged on bail.

4 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for State has vehemently opposed the bail application and submitted that appellant was acting in hand in gloves with the other co-accused persons, who had committed rape with the prosecutrix.
Prosecutrix told that appellant had taken her away and later on other co-accused committed rape with her.

6. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
7.
Considering the fact that rape is not said to have been committed in present or with knowledge of present appellant.
Appellant is a woman and she is in jail since 07.05.2023.
8. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I find it to be a fit case for grant of bail.
Hence, this criminal appeal filed by appellant is allowed.

It is directed that on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) by the appellant along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court concerned, the appellant be released on bail.

9. The appellant shall abide by the conditions stipulated in Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules (VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE tarun Smt. Laxmi Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151934597/
